title: sse: fix chunking/framing for partial JSON and delimiter ordering during streaming
author: Alicia Moreno
commits: Fix framing buffer: treat consecutive delimiter tokens as atomic sequences
Preserve token/event ordering for partial JSON fragments in streamer
Add comprehensive unit tests for delimiter ordering and partial JSON reassembly
Update OpenAI compatibility shim to respect SSE event ordering and delimiters
Add e2e browser streaming smoke test and CI pipeline entry
description:
Summary: This PR fixes a class of streaming stability bugs in the SSE path where partial JSON payloads and delimiter sequences could be emitted in incorrect order or split across frames, causing downstream OpenAI-compatible clients and SDKs to observe malformed JSON or wrong event ordering. The bug typically appeared with high-concurrency workloads or when using prefix/KV cache replay, and was surfaced in production via increased parsing errors in the OpenAI compat shim and flaky client-side JSON parsers.

Motivation: Stable and compatible streaming semantics are critical for structured output, function/tool calling, and OpenAI-compat consumers. Incorrect delimiter/token ordering breaks function invocation, streaming JSON parsing, and leads to customer-visible failures. This change targets correctness first while keeping throughput impact minimal.

What I changed:
- services/sse/framing.py: reworked framing state machine to treat multi-byte delimiter sequences as single tokens during tokenization and to buffer until a safe emission boundary is reached. This prevents splits that produced partial JSON tokens across frames.
- services/sse/streamer.py: changed emission logic to preserve original token/event order even when batching or coalescing frames; added a bounded lookahead to avoid head-of-line blocking while guaranteeing JSON integrity.
- gateway/openai_compat/shim.py: adjusted the compat layer to rely on the streamer guarantees rather than attempting heuristic reassembly, removing a source of duplicate-delimiter insertion.
- SDKs (JS/Python): made small defensive parsing tweaks to be tolerant to single empty events and to surface clearer errors when a stream is terminated mid-object.
- Tests: added unit tests covering delimiter ordering, multi-delimiter edge cases, and a small e2e browser streaming smoke test.
- Observability: added a sse_delimiter_mismatch counter and an SLO check in observability/metrics to detect regressions.

Backwards compatibility and rollout: No API surface breaking changes. The fix is behind a feature flag (runtime.sse.strict_framing) and deployed to canary followed by gradual rollout. Early perf microbench shows <1% throughput impact on our baseline workloads.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests added for framing and ordering
- [x] E2E smoke added for browser streaming
- [x] Updated docs/api/streaming.md with notes about strict framing mode
- [x] Metrics added for delimiter mismatch

Related: Linear ENG-4273 (SSE partial JSON production errors), ENG-4280 (OpenAI shim compatibility fixes).
release_notes: Fixes a streaming bug that could produce malformed partial JSON or incorrect event/delimiter ordering in SSE streams. Improves stability for structured output and OpenAI-compatible streaming consumers. No breaking changes; rollout behind feature flag.
